title: unstructuredgrid cell gradients
explanation:
### Description

Compute cell gradients on an unstructured grid and visualize with tube edges and arrow glyphs.

**input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkArrowSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkArrowSource.html) — generates a 3D arrow.
- [vtkAssignAttribute](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkAssignAttribute.html) — assign attribute.
- [vtkCellCenters](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCellCenters.html) — cell centers.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkExtractEdges](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkExtractEdges.html) — extract edges.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkGradientFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGradientFilter.html) — gradient filter.
- [vtkPointDataToCellData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointDataToCellData.html) — point data to cell data.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkTubeFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTubeFilter.html) — generates tubes around lines with optional radius variation.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridReader.html) — unstructured grid reader.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
